status: Exploratory follow-up chosen after earlier results; frozen before this campaign
question: Does horizon-matched optimizer-state geometry improve finite future-effect fidelity, and does it transfer to an unseen future path?
operator: A_H = derivative of centered post-H logits with respect to initial first moment m, holding initial weights, second moment and clock fixed. Full AdamW tangent/adjoint includes later gradient feedback via Hessian-vector products and both moment dynamics.

fit.chart: Orthonormal 10-class Helmert contrasts, divided by sqrt(10*N)
fit.precision: FP32 native trajectories/autodiff; FP64 Gram eigendecomposition

roles.disjoint: Fit, heldout and first-gradient banks are separate calibration images. Later batches use only original train partition. Response/endpoint test images are separate.

futures.path0: Known batches/labels used to fit H16; primary held-out response test
futures.path1: Unseen later batches/augmentations; shared first calibration update; transfer diagnostic
futures.replication_unit: Training seed. Paths, images and signs are nested; not eight independent seeds.

controls: one tensor-norm-matched random direction plus/minus, sanity only

primary.metric: Immediate relative response error minus horizon-matched relative response error. Central effect=(plus-minus)/2, centered across classes; error=norm(full-projected)/norm(full).
primary.uncertainty: 5000-draw descriptive bootstrap over four reused seeds; not a confirmatory significance test
primary.meaningful_gain_criterion: Mean improvement >=.10, every seed positive, descriptive interval above zero, all primary derivative controls valid

checks.primary_controls: Full, full-half, immediate16 and horizon16 at H16; failed/unresolved controls invalidate a positive mechanism interpretation
checks.heldout_capture: Exact numerator from basis JVPs; trace denominator from 128 independent Rademacher VJP probes; report Monte Carlo SE and normal-approximate interval without clipping estimates
checks.backend: Early actual-state H16 duality and native full/half finite differences before costly fitting

storage.active: Two rolling checkpoint ZIPs and tiny identity/lease records
storage.finished: One verified finished ZIP; checkpoints deleted only after publication verification
storage.resume: Same code/config/backend/GPU required. Verified predecessor fallback. Completed bases/branches skip; uncommitted fitting repeats.

claim_limits: Known-future oracle, not deployable online control
Exact only for this finite fitting bank/state/path
No useful accuracy improvement inferred from response fidelity
Focused diagnostic alongside earlier larger-model evidence, not broad standalone proof
Do not keep changing tests until a positive result; report negative outcomes and earlier frozen results
